description: A nighttime exterior shot of a single-story craftsman-style cottage home photographed from a low-to-standing eye-level, centered symmetrically and looking straight down the entry walkway toward the front door. The house facade is white-painted horizontal lap siding with a dark charcoal-grey pitched roof and a small arched dormer window above the front gable. The entry portico is flanked by white painted columns and features a pair of classic panel double doors in a warm wood stain tone. Two clipped boxwood globe topiary shrubs sit in dark round planters at either side of the entry steps. Large multi-pane windows flank the front facade on both sides, their interiors glowing with a rich honeyed warm light that spills out and illuminates the exterior lawn and foundation plantings. The walkway is a straight concrete path lined with low ornamental grass and a snowy landscape with bare dark garden beds. A golden-leafed autumn tree rises to the left, and snow-dusted mountain peaks fill the background under a deep indigo night sky scattered with stars. Warm amber accent light pools along the pathway leading to the door, creating a welcoming illuminated corridor. The overall mood is welcoming, serene, and gently dramatic — warm domestic glow against a cool dark winter night.
